args.title: Broaden currency symbol stripping in parseAmount
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

In parseAmount, the symbol-stripping regex only removes whitespace and a hardcoded set of currency symbols (€$£¥), missing ₹ and alphabetic prefixes like "CHF ". Broaden the stripping logic (e.g. strip any leading non-digit/sign currency symbol or known currency code prefix) so amounts like "₹1,250.00" and "CHF 1'200.00" parse correctly instead of failing validation.

parseAmount's symbol-stripping regex only handles whitespace and €$£¥, so amounts with ₹ or alphabetic prefixes like "CHF " fail the subsequent digit-only validation and incorrectly return null.
